utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Early afternoon still works for me, and bringing everything to my place is easiest. Just let me know what time you’ll arrive so I can be ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That works for me — I can swing by early afternoon and I’ll message you a bit before I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, thanks — just message me when you’re on your way so I can be ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s really picking up — there’s already a good little crowd over there. If you’re thinking of going, I’d head out soon so you can catch the best stuff before it gets boxed up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll head over soon and keep an eye out near the entrance. Thanks for the heads-up!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nice, Quinn — you should be able to spot the good stuff right by the entrance. Let me know if you hear when they’re setting the next workday, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—if you have the time and place, I’d love the details. And if anything changes, could you keep me posted?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted, and I can share the time and place once Mara confirms the final details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great — I’m still a little behind on the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still spreading the word about the repair drive and repeating the details around the block so folks know where to go. If you hear anything new, just pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll pass along anything I hear, and I can still help once I get there a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Dane — thanks for keeping it moving, even if you’re a bit late. I’ll keep repeating the details around the block so everyone knows where to go.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking whether the repair drive has started or if we’re just gathering donations. Once I confirm, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Hana — just let me know when you confirm, and I’ll head over if repairs are underway.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I will — I’m checking now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm whether repairs are underway.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—I’ve got the time and place nearly locked in, and I’ll send the repair list as soon as I finish confirming a few details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sounds good—can you confirm the exact time and where you want me to bring everything?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — I’m just confirming the last bit, but I’ll send the exact time and drop-off spot right away so you know where to bring everything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds like a solid plan. Let’s sort the broken things first, and then we can match people to each repair.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll handle the squeaky doors and that leaky faucet first. Just point me to where to start.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Sam — start with the squeaky doors, then the faucet. Let me know the place and time, and I’ll keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 8:30 still works for me—I can head over after drop-off. Just let me know if anything changes once the workday is set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye — that works. I’ll let you know if the repair drive schedule changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Mina — I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I should check the list again and match each repair with someone before we start. Then I’ll see what tools we still need and pick a time that works.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds good—once you’ve matched everyone, let me know the place and time and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — I’ll do that and let you know as soon as the list is matched up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I can swing by after 4 and help sort everything out. Just let me know if you need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — after 4 works for me. I might miss a detail or two, so if anything changes, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll keep you posted if anything changes, and I’ll swing by after 4 to help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mara — I’m still keeping track of what we have for the repair drive. I’ll let you know right away if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — that helps a lot. Just keep me posted if you spot any gaps, and I’ll coordinate the rest for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll keep checking the supplies and flag any gaps before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely—if the repair drive needs anything else, I’ve got you covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — I’ve got the small stuff covered for now, but I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo—just give me a holler if you need any extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the repair drive details around the block, Rosa, so everyone knows where to go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that’d be a big help. I’ll send you the time, place, and repair list so you can pass along the right details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — send me the time, place, and repair list, and I’ll keep repeating it around the block so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. Once you’ve got the place and time, I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — early afternoon still works for me, and it’d be easiest if you brought everything to my place. Just let me know the time so I can plan the handoff.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Early afternoon at your place works for me. Just send the exact time, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep it simple today. If you can grab the tools list, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can do that — I’m still catching up, but I’ll grab the tools list and send anything else I hear.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell — that helps a lot. I’ll keep my part simple and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Kira — first I’m making the broken-things list and matching folks to each repair. Once that’s set, I’ll ask around for tools and pick a time to get started.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sounds good — can you confirm when you think you’ll have the list ready? I just want to know if I should head over soon or wait.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I should have the list ready soon, probably in a bit. If you want, come by after that and we can sort the rest together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: After 4 works for me — I’ll bring it by then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, after 4 works—I’ll have the screws and duct tape ready, and I’ll check on the extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — I’ll be there after 4 with the stuff.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: 8:30 still sounds good to me—before pickup, and I can help spread the word once you’re set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, 8:30 works for me — thanks, Jules. I’ll swing by then and help get things ready before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — I’ll spread the word that we’re meeting Saturday at 8:30 and that people can bring tools, spare parts, or extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Mara—if the repair drive is short on tools, just tell me what you need and I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — we could use a few screwdrivers, a wrench set, and any spare screws or bolts you’ve got. Bring them by Saturday morning if you can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Mara—I’ll bring the screwdrivers, wrench set, and whatever spare screws and bolts I can round up on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — I’ll keep sorting the supplies and let you know if we’re still short on anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay — is the repair drive started yet, or are we still gathering donations?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still gathering donations for now — I’m sorting what we have and checking what’s left to get.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll head to the community center on Maple, by the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — the side entrance is the one to use. Go soon, and I’ll keep an ear out for the next workday too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess — I’m on my way to the community center on Maple by the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an ear out, and if I catch any updates, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah — I appreciate that. I’ll keep you posted on the repair drive invite list, too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, Quinn — I might miss a detail here and there, but I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take the squeaky doors and one leaky faucet. Just point me to where to start, and I’ll get on it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great, Sam—thank you. I can point you to the front doors first, and we can keep it moving before school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll head to the front doors first and get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, I can do that — I’ll grab the tools list when I get there, even if I’m a little late.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ll check the tools list too, and I’m still confirming whether the drive has started or if we’re gathering donations.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll stick to the tools list, and if I’m late I’ll catch up once I arrive.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
